script.base: Market has HOME -3.5 in a 47-point game, implied about 25.3–21.8, so a close game with HOME leading late rather than a blowout. HOME cannot lean on the run (L3: PLY17 24/61, 2.54 YPC; X12 16/35; PLY09 11/36; X14 8/24), so they keep throwing to PLY12 (33 tgt, 477 air) and PLY06 (24 tgt, 425 air). AWAY stays in it with PLY03 (55/275, 5.0 YPC, 78.6% of listed L3 carries) early and PLY08 (31 tgt, 318 yds) all game. Pace stays pass-leaning.
script.flip1: HOME jumps two scores early and tries to run clock. AWAY abandons the run, so PLY03's carry share dies, while chase mode funnels targets to PLY08 and PLY04. HOME's own 2.5 YPC run game may not actually hold that lead, so this flip is only clean if the score gets out of hand.
script.flip2: Pressure game or uncharted weather turns it into a slog under 47. AWAY blitzes 37% and HOME QB EPA is -0.07 vs blitz (n=99) vs +0.22 clean; HOME blitzes 33% and AWAY QB is -0.01 vs blitz (n=69) vs +0.16 clean. Both WR overs die if play count and explosives shrink. The other upward flip is a shootout where PLY08 and PLY12 clear together.

edge_players.edge_sentence: PLY08 has 318 receiving yards on 31 targets over the last 3 games (106 a game) and HOME allows 7.11 YPA to the left plus 13 gains of 20+ yards, so 73 is under that role even if efficiency fades some.
edge_players.must_be_true: PLY08 keeps a full route share near 8–11 targets and the game does not become a low-play clock grind with AWAY already ahead. Survives the base script and the trail flip (chase mode adds targets).
edge_players.kills_it: A blowout AWAY lead that stalls WR volume, an uncharted bracket, or the 318 yards being one fluke catch rather than a stable role. Price is +nan, so a hidden short number kills the bet even if the read is right. A slog flip also kills it.

edge_players.edge_sentence: PLY12 has 266 receiving yards on 33 targets over 3 games (88.7 a game) with 477 air yards, and AWAY allows 7.93 YPA in the middle, so 57.5 is light if that target share holds in a 47-point game.
edge_players.must_be_true: Script-dependent: HOME stays pass-leaning because the run game (PLY17 2.54 YPC on 24 carries) cannot take the game over, and PLY12 keeps about 10+ targets. Tagged script-dependent because a blowout lead or a slog both cut the leg.
edge_players.kills_it: AWAY's 37% blitz, where HOME QB EPA is -0.07 (n=99), plus another air-yard miss (only 266 yards already on 477 air) lands him under 57.5. A HOME lead that actually becomes a run script does the same.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both overs lost. AWAY blitzed at 37% and it showed up in HOME QB's -0.07 blitz EPA, so PLY12's 477 air yards became another incomplete-heavy night under 57.5. HOME also got ahead, AWAY did not need a full WR1 night, and PLY08's 318-yard L3 was one long catch that did not repeat, finishing in the 50s under 73. No coverage chart and no inactives means a late shadow or a snap limit is the miss this pack could not catch. The 47 closed under in a pressure game, and both pass overs needed the base script.
slip_story: Base-script pass-volume stack for a 47 total, not a TD slip: HOME cannot run (L3 YPC under 3.3) so PLY12 recyds over 57.5, and AWAY as a 3.5-point dog keeps PLY08 (31 targets L3) involved over 73. Both die together in the slog flip, so this slip is the competitive/shootout story only. Do not add PLY03 rushyds over 67.5 — that leg needs AWAY to stay run-positive and dies on the trail flip that helps PLY08. PLY06 over 71.5 (88 vs 71.5) is the same-script candidate but was not selected; thinner cushion and the same blitz risk.
